trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. No multiplayer or DLC is needed, and the whole list can be finished in one playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies in this guide, in any order.
The platinum unlocks the moment the last one pops.
No online trophy exists, so everything is done solo.

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. It is automatic story progress and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play through the opening of Chapter 1.
Complete the mission Gone Fishing.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The chapter closes after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every Chapter 1 story mission.
Start and finish the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter closes after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through every Chapter 2 story mission.
Start and finish the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. The chapter closes after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every Chapter 3 story mission.
Complete the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Its last mission is Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every Chapter 4 story mission.
Complete the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. After the credits, free-roam opens and the remaining trophies can be cleaned up.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission.
Complete the final mission and watch the credits.
Free-roam opens afterwards for all remaining trophies.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Reach the mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach the mission Headliners in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach the mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks automatically as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which opens after the story ends under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and the checklist is weighted about 60% true completion despite the 100% label.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion).
Work through the three checklist groups: Story and Tasks 45%, Exploration and Activities 45%, Discovery 10%.
Finish every listed requirement, including 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges.
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the 397 stunts in the world: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Categories can be mixed, and under-the-bridge passes are the fastest to farm.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, or on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots.
Mix stunt jumps, under-the-bridge passes, knife flights and base jumps until 250 are done.
Under-the-bridge passes are the quickest repeatable category.
Note: 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Most of these happen naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Check Progress, Activities to see which of the 9 types are still untried.
Fish once, hunt once, play a round of golf, enter a shooting range, play pool, score a basketball hoop, play a video game, win any race, and perform one stunt.
The trophy pops when the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold medals in all 42 shooting range challenges across 12 locations. This is widely rated the second hardest trophy after A Long Road, so raise your Focus level first.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Raise Focus before grinding: play the shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and land headshots to level it up.
Visit all 12 shooting range locations and clear every challenge.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges (18 at Griffin, 24 elsewhere).
Use the Focus farm trick: short shooting range loops raise Focus quickly.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and winning at each location once is enough for the trophy.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race markers across the map.
Win at least one drone race at each of the 14 locations.
The trophy pops when the fourteenth location is won.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of 40 unique race locations. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count toward the total.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races at different locations around Leonida.
Win 20 different races; car races, race challenges and drone races all count.
The trophy pops on the twentieth distinct win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon; follow his fishing questline until you can challenge him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Complete the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text marking a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline and win the fishing challenge against him.

trophies.guide: Finish one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind (all playable on the home TV with a controller from Chapter 1) or Bang For Your Buck (on an arcade machine in the world). You must finish every level, but not every challenge.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Pick one of the four arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck.
The first three can be played on the home TV from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck needs an arcade machine in the world.
Finish every level of the chosen game. Challenges are optional.
Note: the 100% checklist counts playing all four games, so this trophy only partly overlaps it.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges listed under Progress, Challenges. This trophy comes naturally on the road to 100%, which needs 70 of 80, so pick the easiest challenges last.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see all 80 challenges.
Complete any 50 of them, saving the easiest for last.
The trophy pops at 50; 100% completion needs 70, so keep going.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on the phone (hold D-pad Up + R1). More than 100 locations exist: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so any 100 will do.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app on the phone, hold D-pad Up and press R1 to scan.
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags as you explore.
Any 100 scanned locations count; the world holds more than 100.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total). The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so this trophy is an early milestone on that road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards found across Leonida and track sets under Progress, Collections.
Complete any 3 of the 18 sets to pop the trophy.
Keep collecting afterwards: 100% completion needs 15 of 18 sets.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 unique vehicles with WAiNK (hold D-pad Up, aim at a vehicle, hold R1). You do not need to drive them; scanning is enough. Stand on a busy street and scan traffic as it passes.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Open WAiNK on the phone, hold D-pad Up, aim at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; driving is not required.
Track scanned vehicles under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
The trophy pops at 100 unique vehicles; 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. This is the only trophy that can be missed: the first meditation, on Jason's home balcony in Chapter 1, disappears when Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and follow her to the balcony when she offers to meditate. Choose Accept. Do this before Chapter 1 ends.
Afterwards, visit the remaining meditation spots across the 10 locations.
Meditate as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot to count it twice.
Track spots under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The trophy needs 18 of 18; 100% only needs 15 of 18.
Save manually before Down to Earth as a safety net. Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is strictly required is still unconfirmed, so do it anyway.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is exclusive to Lucia in Chapter 3. Wait for Andy's call, then follow the text with his home address in Belville and complete all five quests.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and wait for Andy's phone call.
Follow the text with Andy's home address in Belville.

Complete the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
The trophy pops after the final quest.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline, starting in Chapter 1. After the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), Kenton calls and marks a green KR icon at Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving for 7 shipwreck sets with a metal detector.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Complete the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton).
Answer Kenton's call and follow the green KR marker at Key Lento.
Dive for treasure with the metal detector and bring each find back to Kenton.
After the first set, Kenton calls again for the next set; finish all sets.
Kenton is briefly unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3; as Jason, call Brian to speed his return. Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, starting in Chapter 2. After the mission Coffee Break, Billy is marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub marker in Kelly County.
Complete the five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops after the final quest.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands that the game actually counts. Many questlines do not count toward this total (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others have their own trophies), so use the confirmed strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Complete Kirk's strand: Search for the Skunk Ape, Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics.
Complete Kyle's strand: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?, Check on Kyle.
Complete Yago's strand: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Mentor Yago, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother, Back Up Yago.
Complete Pilot Pete's strand: The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries: Southpoint Airfield, Pete's Deliveries: Avery Allen and Co., Deliver Packages.
The trophy pops when 8 counted strands are done. More strangers may still be undiscovered, so check the in-game trophy tracker.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline in Chapter 3. After the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), the Key Cloner unlocks and Randy hands you a list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy).

Take Randy's wish list of 16 sports cars: Granforma Zorrusso, Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Banshee, Gallivanter Baller ST-D.
Steal the cars from the street (often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, in front of hotels) or from marked spots; scan with WAiNK to check a car is on the list.
Deliver each car to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Better condition pays more.
Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, exclusive to Jason in Chapter 3. After the mission Here, Kitty Kitty, a purple Synthetic Labs marker appears in Vice City; destroy the labs until Tyrone gives you the final quest.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play as Jason and complete the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty.
Follow the purple Synthetic Labs marker in Vice City and destroy labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs).
Complete it to pop the trophy.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, exclusive to Jason in Chapter 2. After the mission Coffee Break, Bret texts you and marks the first hunt, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. He lends you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 from the Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Play as Jason and complete the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Answer Bret's text and go to the purple-marked first hunt, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County.
Pick up the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle from the Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Follow Bret's marked hunting spots, hunt the requested animal and bring it back to him. A clean single shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more.
Track hunts under Map, Activities, Target Deck. There are 15 Target Decks in total, and 100% needs all 15, so this trophy partly overlaps the checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and escape until you leave the red heat zone, not just the flashing blue and red search area. Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Chapter 2 Coffee Break, call your partner (hold D-pad Right + Triangle).
Build a 4-star wanted level.
Escape until you are fully out of the red heat zone.
Easiest escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow on the rails and helicopters cannot see you. A fast sports bike cutting across routes also works.
This trophy usually pops automatically during a big bank vault robbery, which always triggers a 4-star wanted level.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while the police are chasing you, keeping the flashing red and blue wanted level the whole time without entering the red heat level. The trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: After Chapter 2 Coffee Break, bring your partner along (hold D-pad Right + Triangle).
Wear body armor and carry sticky bombs plus Zombix or Adrenaline.
Rob three shops back to back while keeping the wanted level flashing red and blue; do not let it rise into the red heat level.
Good spot: the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob items and blow the back safe with a sticky bomb.
If the trophy does not pop about 30 seconds after the third shop, rob a fourth shop.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). Time slows for only a few seconds, so prepare first: buff Focus, take Adrenaline to extend the duration, and fight five enemies standing close together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise Focus first: shooting range, golf, pool, fishing and headshots level it up. Check Focus under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Focus (purple eye icon). Focus level 4 makes this much easier.
Buff Focus by eating, drinking and washing up at home, then take Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the slow-motion window.
Use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556 and wear body armor.
Find five enemies grouped together, for example criminals in Gang Operations, and trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming).
Note: this does not work on soldiers, police or civilians.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is connected to a boarding bridge at VCIA (Vice City International Airport), not a plane on the field. The easiest planes are at terminals E3 and E4. Hidden status is not yet verified: the official list has 28 hidden trophies and one non-story hidden slot is still unidentified, with this trophy as a candidate, so it is not marked hidden here.
trophies.hidden_note: Hidden status unverified — one of two candidates for the 16th non-story hidden slot.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Enter VCIA through the airfield fence and head to terminal E3 or E4.
Climb the stairs beside a boarding bridge; the door leads straight into a connected passenger plane.
Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, push the plane back to the runway and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport until the trophy pops; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, on the island in the south-west of the map in Mariana County; the tanks sit south of the base. Hidden status is not yet verified: the official list has 28 hidden trophies and one non-story hidden slot is still unidentified, with this trophy as a candidate, so it is not marked hidden here.
trophies.hidden_note: Hidden status unverified — one of two candidates for the 16th non-story hidden slot.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County and enter through the gate or over the south-east stunt jump.
Find the Rhino tanks south of the base and climb into one.
Shoot enemies with the tank; if the trophy does not pop, fire the main cannon.
Keep fighting until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun: it silently lockpicks alarmed doors and stays in your inventory permanently.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store robbery (green icon) and enter through the back door with the Snap Gun. Do not kick the door in; that triggers the alarm.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe.
Good spot: Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van location tips.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe).
Follow a security van until it stops at a bank; when the guard carries a bag into the vault, enter while the vault is open and rob it. Bring your partner to hand over one bag (hold D-pad Right).
Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips on security-van locations (purple icon). Finish two Payday Loans robberies first to unlock Yasmani as a fence.
Robbing a vault triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch vehicles.
Rob 5 vaults for the trophy; 100% needs all 8 large bank jobs. One bank can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The safest route is through the Chapter 4 bank vault mission, which counts as robbing an armored truck. Warning: robbing a truck directly has a reported bug where the trophy can fail to pop.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Safest route: complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… and rob the large bank vault; it counts as robbing an armored truck.

Faster but riskier route: block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, stick a sticky bomb on its back door, detonate it, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold behind Yasmani's shop after his quest.
Warning: the trophy can fail to pop if you rob a truck directly, so use the bank vault route if it fails.

trophies.guide: Open the whole map fog. The fastest way is to fly a plane over every blacked-out foggy area until the full map is revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly over every fogged part of the map.
Keep flying until no black fog remains anywhere.
The trophy pops when the whole map is revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total; 100% needs all 39. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you get close.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Look for yellow illegal-operation icons on the map; many are marked automatically from the story.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track per-gang progress under Progress, Gangs (scroll each gang to see robbed operations at bottom right).
The trophy pops after the ninth gang; 100% needs all 39 operations.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Buy an Apple Martini ($10) at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar in the Oceanview Hotel on Ocean Beach and drink it standing beside the bar. This trophy was only solved on the evening of 20 Nov 2026; before that every guide listed it as unknown.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel, Ocean Beach.
Walk past the pool and take the lift up to the rooftop.
Buy an Apple Martini ($10) at the rooftop bar and drink it while standing beside the bar.
The trophy pops after drinking.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City, clone the key of the blue Banshee, then drive straight through the showroom window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs to unlock the Key Cloner.
Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City.
Clone the key of the blue Bravado Banshee.
Drive straight through the showroom window and keep driving until the trophy pops; the pop is slightly delayed.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal three valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation): a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east corner table, and a safe in the north-east hallway blown open with a sticky bomb. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you take the third item.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. The optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling marks the location.
Steal the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east corner table), and blow the safe in the north-east hallway with a sticky bomb.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape, not on the third item.
Not missable: if you do not finish everything at once, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so return and steal the rest.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength (heart icon). Only possible after Chapter 2 Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Note: one source calls this a story trophy instead; see the disagreement panel.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Reach Chapter 2 Coffee Break so you can switch characters.
Raise Strength by working out: buy a fitness club membership (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon; many in Vice City) or work out at home after the story.
Always bring your partner (hold D-pad Right + Triangle): while one character works out, the other gains progress too, doubling progress.
Check Strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, Strength, and keep both at maximum at the same time.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Track progress by clicking the trophy in the trophy list (it shows X/500). Turn on notifications under Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On, so every reputation action shows a small devil-face icon on the right of the screen.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications: Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On.

Play normally: completing objectives, robbing quietly, destroying evidence and escaping cleanly builds the Professional profile; non-lethal takedowns build Hardened; killing builds Violent; killing many police or civilians builds Psycho.
The trophy almost always pops naturally during a full playthrough.
Fastest farm if you are short: run over pedestrians or police with a car. Warning: the Psycho and Irredeemable profiles make police shoot on sight, and Irredeemable is permanent.

trophies.guide: Return to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, Vice City, the store Lucia robbed in the Prologue, as Lucia alone (without Jason), rob it again as in the prologue (aim a weapon at the teller, take the money), then escape on foot, not in a vehicle. This trophy was only solved on the evening of 20 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Play as Lucia alone, without Jason, and go to the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Rob it again like the prologue: aim a weapon at the teller and take the money.
Escape on foot, not in a vehicle, and keep running until the trophy pops; the pop is delayed.
Timing note: PowerPyx says this is possible from Chapter 2, while damnmodz lists the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3 as the best lead. See the disagreement panel.

trophies.guide: A random UFO event: after Chapter 1, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County (east of Port Gellhorn) after 02:00 in-game time. Look for a parked car with flashing lights at the roadside; follow the trail into the woods toward a blue light, where a UFO is lifting a woman. Help her, return to the car, and the UFO returns to abduct you. This trophy was only solved on the evening of 20 Nov 2026.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: After Chapter 1, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, east of Port Gellhorn, after 02:00 in-game time.
Look for a parked car with flashing lights at the roadside. If there is none, leave and come back; the spawn is random.
Follow the trail into the woods toward the blue light, where a UFO is lifting a woman.
Help the woman (agree to fetch her car), then return to the car at the road. The UFO comes back and abducts your character, popping the trophy.

Works as Jason or Lucia. Second encounter (not a trophy): after the abduction your character dreams; note the number above the keypad in the dream (usually 2134). Go to South Point Airfield, Hamlet, climb the radio tower fence from the left, go up to the roof by the stairs, enter the hatch, go down, enter code 2134, take the lift to the basement, press the panel buttons until all lights are green, pull the lever, take the milk bottle from the table (through the left door, watch the radiation), put it in the capsule in the right room, and an alien appears. Carry it away before the poison gas, return to the lift, and a UFO comes to collect the alien.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNKNOWN — the only trophy whose unlock is still unverified as of 21 Nov 2026, 00:30 WIB. Best lead from PowerPyx: kick an enemy during a melee drive-by from a motorcycle. No source has proven the exact steps, so do not treat any how-to as confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Best lead only, unverified: ride a motorcycle past an enemy and try a melee drive-by kick.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn a cumulative $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect marked bills.
Bring marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 total is cumulative, not all at once. One bank vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. Fastest on weapons, car mods and tattoos (the most expensive). Shops: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Spray, 24 Ammu-Nation, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios, 15 electronics stores.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shop types until the cumulative total hits $100,000.
Fastest: weapons, car modifications and tattoos, which are the priciest.
The total is cumulative across all shops, so normal shopping during the story already counts.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (total $160,000; 4 story garages do not count). Garages can be bought after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on the phone. Buy through the app.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) to unlock garage purchases.
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages for a total of $160,000.
Fastest money: robberies, especially in Chapters 3-4, and large bank vaults paying up to $205,000 each.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need a garage first, since each garage adds parking slots. Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray then Register in his garage.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to install the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking slots.
Bring a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, click Respray, then Register in his garage.
Registration costs money, so use cheap cars or bikes. From Chapter 3, standard tracked cars can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray; at first Moses only takes vehicles without a tracker.
Register 10 vehicles to pop the trophy.
